title: Swarm learning predicts colorectal cancer mutations from histopathology slides
summary: Swarm learning, which trains models across partner sites without moving patient data, was applied to over 5,000 patients to predict BRAF status and microsatellite instability from H&E colorectal cancer slides. Swarm-trained models outperformed most locally trained models and matched models trained on merged datasets, and were validated on two independent UK datasets. Caveat: the outcome is a research-grade prediction from slides, not a clinical test.
ai_technology: Swarm learning with deep learning on histopathology images
organization: University of Oxford; Belfast Health and Social Care Trust; University of Leeds
